company_name: Hosei University, Research Center of Ion Beam Technology
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The center is involved in semiconductor materials and processes, specifically in GaN power device fabrication and evaluation.
summary: Hosei University's Research Center of Ion Beam Technology focuses on the fabrication and evaluation of GaN power devices, particularly freestanding substrate p-n junction diodes with ultra-low on-resistance and high voltage resistance. The center also conducts collaborative research in high-energy ion implantation and Rutherford Backscattering analysis, contributing to advancements in semiconductor materials.
capabilities: GaN freestanding substrate p-n junction diodes
